title.narrative: Ligada: DFID Mozambique Support to Adolescent Girls and Women - Support Staff

description.narrative: This activity Ligada: DFID Mozambique Support to Adolescent Girls and Women - Support Staff is a component of MUVA - Women's Economic Empowerment Programme in Mozambique ( formerly known as LIGADA) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £1,081,645. It works in the following sector(s): Basic life skills for adults.
